This can solve the problem of "disappearing" docks when using custom plugins.

Look at the EditorDebugger here:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/97205e65-afc5-44be-9a2a-26ef89772780

With `is_exiting()` check:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/016be538-e655-4e11-b970-bb81ba56f911

We should probably update documentation to recommend using this method.
